chapters.reason: The paper explicitly introduces a discrete diffusion model (MGDM) that operates on discrete tokens, which aligns with the definition of masked diffusion models.
The paper focuses on complex reasoning and planning tasks (Countdown, Sudoku, SAT) and demonstrates how the proposed diffusion approach outperforms autoregressive models in these domains.
The paper positions its approach as an alternative to autoregressive models and discusses the limitations of autoregression, making it relevant to the hybrid/comparative study of these paradigms.
